How to use this pack

Finance will walk through this pack on the call and ask questions as we go. The answers need pages that come BEFORE the question.

  1. Page 2 has monthly volumes per lane. Page 3 has the rate card per carrier and lane.
  2. Page 4 is a picture puzzle: it names the carrier we are consolidating to. Decode it; do not guess.
  3. Page 5 has the fuel surcharge rule and the growth assumption. Page 6 has on-time performance.
  4. Pages 7 and 8 are memos with the questions. Costs = pallets × rate, then minimum charge, then surcharge.
Rounding: give dollar answers to the nearest dollar.
